title: System Architecture
summary: Describes the LLM Gateway's architecture: request flow, provider abstraction and model routing, SSE streaming, authentication, analytics, configuration, and web playground.
notes: No frontmatter or filename convention; docs/ path leans DOC, but dominant content signals are SPEC (analytics endpoint tables with response shapes, request/response schemas, SSE protocol fields, SQLite request_logs data model, env-var config contracts); SPEC wins over DOC per precedence tie-break. Filename suffix uses parent-dir disambiguator 'docs' instead of SHA-256(path) prefix: no shell/execution tool available in this environment (hub process spawn broken, ENOENT), basename is unique repo-wide, and this matches the path-derived-id precedent set by sibling classification plan-04192337.json.
